title: v1_118
content: # Visual Studio Code 1.118 Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/vs-code), [X](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=533687), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/vscode.dev) --- _Release date: April 29, 2026_ --- Welcome to the 1.118 release of Visual Studio Code. This release expands where you can work with Copilot agents and makes them more efficient. Here are the highlights for this release: * [Remote control](#remote-control-for-copilot-cli-sessions-experimental): Track and control your ongoing Copilot CLI sessions remotely from GitHub.com or mobile. * [Codebase search](#codebase-search-and-context): Find the code you need with semantic search in any workspace and text search across GitHub repos and orgs. * [Dedicated context for skills](#dedicated-context-for-skills-experimental): Isolate skill execution to keep your main chat focused and answers sharper. * [Chat session insights](#chronicle-experimental): Turn your chat history into standup reports, tips, and answers about past work. * [Enterprise control](#approved-account-organizations-policy): Restrict AI feature access to organizations your admin trusts. * [Improved token efficiency](#improving-token-efficiency): Get more out of every request with lower token usage. Happy Coding! ---
